# 1.2.114 - the GM redirects an Objection, the trial's modes mute who may not speak, a playlist for each mode and three for Scrum Debate, and the trial's sounds

One stage on 1.2.113 (8a66fb8b's release, tag v1.2.113): E110, the Class Trial's changes the owner asked for on
14.11.2026 ("Niech 1.2.114 bedzie etapem na zmiany w class trial"). Everything else planned for this version moved to
1.2.115 (E56, E109, E59, E39, E40, E43, E53, E58, E83) and 1.3.0 (E26), as tools/stages.json says.
From v1.2.113 to 66d0fdcb, the tree before this release commit: 14 commits, 1 of them the merge of 1.2.113's
release into the line (`git rev-list --count` and `--merges --count` over v1.2.113..66d0fdcb).

In plain words:

**The GM redirects an Objection.**
- **Re-point works in the Objection's minute and in its Rebuttal.** The GM picks a new target from the trial console's
  bar or its dialog; the new target is judged as a fresh Objection's would be (not the objector, a participant, alive)
  and must be here (a player connected). The same target again is refused with its own line, and so is an absent one.
- **One step writes every copy of the target**: the floor, the Objection's card (found by the newest entry of the
  floor's stack, so it works when the GM raised the card too), its flags and the receipt. The clock is not restarted
  (the owner's answer to Q-E110-2). A public card tells the table the GM redirected the Objection, naming the objector
  and the new target.
- **Both of the GM's roads end in the same step**: the console's Re-point and another GM's or the API's floor step
  (the owner kept both, Q-E110-11). A second press at the same target writes nothing.

**The trial's modes mute who may not speak.**
- **While a mode gives the floor to someone, every other player is muted by the module** (the owner's words of 14.11:
  "Tryby class trial ... niech wycisza automatycznie graczy, ktorych nie dopuszczaja do glosu"). The floor's speakers
  are: the objector in an Objection (from the press, while they still pick the Truth Bullet, Q-E110-4), the objector
  and the answerer in a Rebuttal, the turn's speaker in a round (Nonstop Debate, Testimony, Panic Round), and the
  speaker of a Closing Argument's or a Scrum Debate's speaking phase.
- **No speaker, no muting**: a Closing Argument's volunteers and choice, Scrum Debate's Sides and Confer, a Straw Poll
  and a Logic Dive mute nobody by mode.
- **Who is never muted by mode**: a GM, a Spectator by their own switch, and nobody once the floor ends, the turn
  passes, the trial ends, the season is reset or the primary GM changes. A GM's own hand block is never undone by it,
  and nothing stays muted after a reload.
- **Monocubs are muted too** (the owner's decision D-E110-A of 14.11: "W tych trybach monocuby tez maja byc
  wyciszane"); until now the module never held a Monocub's microphone.
- **A murder's mask does not apply in the trial**: the trial's own muting decides there (Q-E110-16). In a Night
  Eclipse the mask stands as before.
- **The voice line and the HUD say why**: "The floor is X's", or both names in a Rebuttal, in English and Polish.
- Muting by mode starts only once the trial was entered by one of the module's roads (the trial's list written, as
  for the dead in 1.2.110; Q-E110-7).

**Gaps in the trial closed.**
- **The vote's opening ends any floor** (a round, a zone mode, a debate, an exchange), as it already ended a Closing
  Argument; the vote's own card tells the table, and a Logic Dive stopped by it keeps where it stopped (Q-E110-8).
- **A Straw Poll's split is taken back by any mode's start** (Q-E110-9): before, a split poll offered Scrum Debate for
  the rest of the trial.
- **The Event panel's "Next" skips a player who is not here**, as the floor's machine passes them.
- **A Scrum Debate speaker has Done, Pass and Post thesis** in their turn's window (Q-E110-10); a speaker whose player
  leaves is passed.

**Music: a playlist for each mode, three for Scrum Debate** (the owner's decisions D-E110-B and D-E110-C of 14.11:
"Kazda minigra w class trial niech ma wlasna playliste w muzyce", "Scrum trzy playlisty niech ma").
- The Music tab has a row for the Rebuttal, Testimony, Panic Round, Closing Argument, Straw Poll and Logic Dive, three
  for Scrum Debate (Sides, Camps confer, the debate's turns) and one for the vote (from its opening, or its count, to
  the verdict; Q-E110-14). Nonstop Debate and the Objection keep the states they had.
- **A row with no playlist plays what played until now**, so a world that maps nothing hears no change.

**Sounds** (the coordinator's survey of 14.11 for the owner's "czy w module nie brakuje zadnych dzwiekow ani
playlist"; no audio file is added to the module).
- **New events in the Sound window**: "Truth Bullet presented" (`present`, heard by the whole table and the GMs;
  Q-E110-13), "A hidden stash found" (`stashFound`, heard by the searcher and the GMs; a Find Stash that finds nothing
  plays the search's "nothing" sound) and "Your bedroom was entered" (`bedroomEntered`, heard by the bedroom's owner
  alone).
- **One sound for one moment, in either order**: a sound that gives way to a more specific one now gives way when the
  winner arrives first too, within 120 ms (Q-E110-12); a winner with no file mapped silences nothing. A Truth Bullet
  copy gives way to Monokuma's Reveal and to a Present; a chat card gives way to a New Rule, a Motive and a Public
  Announcement.
- **The trial's own cues fixed**: the debate's opening sound plays for a debate alone, and a Scrum Debate speaker
  hears "your turn".
- **The Messenger switch silences all three messenger sounds** when they come on a card, not only the GM's question
  (Q-E110-15).
- Texts: the safeword's line when no file is mapped, the Music switch's hint and the Music tab's trial note.

**Fixed from 1.2.113.**
- **A secret project's open card could keep its old description** on a player's browser after the GM changed it: the
  card redrew when the card's words arrived but not when the player's copy of what they see arrived, and the
  description reads that copy first. When the words came first, the old text stayed until the card was opened again.
  The card now redraws on both (4a8d9c0c, R7110; found by scenario 30, red in 1 of 5 runs before).

## Before installing

- **No world migration** and **no new stored data**: E110 writes into the records the trial already keeps (its floor,
  its progress and its card's flags).
- **Language**: lang/en.json goes from 6054 to 6077 keys: 23 added, none removed, 2 changed in wording (counted on the
  flattened files, v1.2.113 against 66d0fdcb). lang/pl.json has the same keys.
- **Nothing to map**: every new music state and sound plays only once the GM maps a playlist or a file to it.
